name: Table 1-7: Gravity
_doc: Determines the gravity of a Planet, which affects Orbital Features count and Atmospheric Presence. Roll on Rocky or Gas Giant subtable.

rocky_planets.name: Low Gravity
rocky_planets.description: Apply -10 to any roll on Table 1-8: Orbital Features. Apply -2 to any roll on Table 1-9: Atmospheric Presence. Follows the rules for Low Gravity Worlds (RT Core p.269).

rocky_planets.name: Normal Gravity
rocky_planets.description: This Planet's gravity is roughly Terran Standard.

rocky_planets.name: High Gravity
rocky_planets.description: Add +10 to any roll on Table 1-8: Orbital Features. Add +1 to the roll on Table 1-9: Atmospheric Presence. Follows the rules for High Gravity Worlds (RT Core p.269).

gas_giants.name: Weak
gas_giants.description: Add +10 to any roll on Table 1-8: Orbital Features.

gas_giants.name: Strong
gas_giants.description: Add +15 to any roll on Table 1-8: Orbital Features.

gas_giants.name: Powerful
gas_giants.description: The influence of this gravity well extends well beyond the immediate presence of its source, drawing in whatever passes by. Add +20 to any roll on Table 1-8: Orbital Features.

gas_giants.name: Titanic
gas_giants.description: Effects on the System are second only to its Star. Add +30 to any roll on Table 1-8: Orbital Features.
